title: Native SwiftUI workspace manager
summary: Mac desktop surface for workspace status, task binding, editors and independent CPU/GPU renderer actions.

dates.note: Exact start/end dates are not documented. Technical mechanisms are reported in the October 5, 2026 snapshot; any later owner clarifications are cited per fact.

facts.text: Developed a Swift/SwiftUI workspace manager exposing workspace status, task binding, editor launch, warnings and process controls.
Extended the native manager with independent CPU and GPU build, run, focus and termination actions, covering eight renderer-specific operations.
